About the Festival

Where management meets culture

Xpressions is the annual management and cultural festival of Xavier Institute of Management, Bhubaneswar (XIM University). Year after year, it has brought together students, artists and guests for competitions, performances and celebrations.

Compete against students from 20+ institutes, perform in front of a full campus, or simply enjoy the concerts, comedy and EDM nights.

Compete

Win prizes and recognition, and add real experience to your résumé.

Create

Music, dance, theatre, fashion and more.

Celebrate

Enjoy concerts, comedy and EDM nights with the campus community.

Festival Itinerary

Three days at Xpressions

A proposed day-by-day plan to help participants organise their fest. Timings and the final line-up are tentative and will be updated once confirmed.

Morning · Welcome

Participant check-in, registration desk, inauguration and a briefing on event rules and venues.

Proposed

Afternoon · First rounds

Preliminary rounds of management, finance, case-study, quiz and cultural competitions.

Proposed

Evening · Campus live

Opening performances, informal campus activities and the first headline act.

Proposed

Morning · Round two

Advanced rounds, workshops, quizzes and team challenges across the festival venues.

Proposed

Afternoon · Semi-finals

Case presentations, business simulations, cultural showcases and shortlisting of finalists.

Proposed

Evening · Comedy & music

A comedy night, student performances and headline entertainment.

Proposed

Morning · Grand finals

Final rounds of flagship management and cultural competitions, followed by judging.

Proposed

Afternoon · Awards

Results, prize distribution, felicitation of winners, the closing ceremony and group photos.

Proposed

Evening · Closing night

A final concert or EDM night, and the closing celebration of Xpressions.

Get Your Pass

Pass and entry rules from Xpressions’25

  • Register separately for Day 1 and Day 2. Registrations beyond capacity are waitlisted.
  • Passes are not sold. They are issued through registration, one per ID, and sent to your registered email address.
  • Single entry only: there is no re-entry after leaving the venue.
  • XIMB and XIM University students enter with their college ID.
  • External attendees must register to receive an entry pass.
  • Comedy Night is first come, first served. EDM Night is open to registered attendees.
  • By registering, you consent to being photographed and filmed for promotional use.

The 2027 pass policy will be confirmed by the organising team and updated here.

Need Answers?

FAQs

Is Xpressions only for management students?

No. It combines business competitions with music, dance, theatre, fashion, comedy and concerts, so there is something for every kind of talent.

Are passes free or paid?

In 2025, passes were not for sale and were issued through registration. Check back here for the confirmed 2027 policy.

Do XIM University students need a pass?

In 2025, XIMB and XIM University students entered with their college ID.

Can I re-enter after leaving the venue?

In 2025, entry was single-use only, with no re-entry.

When and where is the fest?

The probable dates are 21–23 January 2027. Final dates and venue details will be confirmed by the organising team.
